text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board, huh? Well, at least I 
got something to show for my hard work, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it aiming too high to wish I'd taken 
1st? To be totally frank... what did you 
think of today's result?
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's definitely take 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it aiming too high to wish I'd taken 
1st? To be totally frank... what did you 
think of today's result?
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's definitely take 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you being serious right now? I'm 
honestly pretty bummed that I lost, you 
know.
choice_data_list: We can definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, claiming that without any shred of 
proof. ...Though having you believe in me 
like that actually feels pretty nice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I definitely felt something, you know? 
Like, "Hey, I'm actually pretty good at 
this!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm all fired up. Next time, I'll 
show you results you can be even more 
proud of!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, keep your voice down out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's a relief. It means you 
believe I can aim even higher too, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just placing isn't enough for me. I want 
to win and be recognized as a strong horse 
girl.
choice_data_list: Then there's nothing to do but practice!
Then we just have to practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There it is, the fiery passion. But hey, 
bring it on. I don't care how dirty or 
gritty it gets, I'll do whatever it takes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
By doing that, I'm gonna show you an even 
more amazing "me"!
